items.title: Junior Mance Part I interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, New York City, New York, July 27, 1995…
items.q: I was in the Army with Cannonball, Cannonball and Nat.

ctx.x: Tell us, you did some work with the Adderleys.
Yeah. I was in the Army with Cannonball, Cannonball and Nat. © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-
First of all I got to say if I had to pick a quintet that just to me had a beautiful jazz feeling and a beautiful soul feeling it would be the Cannonball quintet.
